name: Thorvald_TowerShield
description: House Thorvald Elite tower shield, hand-modelled to the reference sheet: 0.56 x 1.20 m chamfered slab, bent across its width, raised worn-copper rim round a recessed dark steel face, copper inner line, rust grime, scratches, copper gear-and-star emblem, dark viewing slot; grip bar on the back. No energy effects.
rebuild: blender -b --python make_shield.py ; python paint_shield.py ; blender -b --python make_shield.py -- --shots
notes: Weapon space = Gurney's shield (GurneySet_Shield): x across, z up, front -y, hand at the origin. Vanilla prefab: y -0.04091 z 0.01254 rotationX -98.2 rotationY -2.3 rotationZ 0.3 on ...B_lWristJ.B_Shield; in Blender (bone_local) rotation (-8.2, -2.3, 0.3). Gurney's own shield (energy halo + chevron removed) was tried first: candidates/.
